Alger, 7 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 7, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The 7th World Media Summit opened on Saturday, November 7, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, focusing on the integration of artificial intelligence into the press. Bringing together nearly 500 delegates from 112 countries, including Algeria, the event addresses the governance and transformation of editorial models.

Des dirigeants d'organisations médiatiqu: Leaders of media organizations, think tank representatives, government officials, and United Nations delegates gathered in the Chinese capital. Jointly organized by the Xinhua News Agency and the Beijing municipality, this international meeting is dedicated to the editorial and economic transformations generated by the adoption of smart digital tools in newsrooms.
La représentation algérienne est assurée: Algerian representation is ensured by the APS news agency and the daily newspaper Le Jeune Indépendant. Participants are examining ways to make artificial intelligence accessible to all stakeholders while strengthening international collaboration in fact-checking, joint investigations, and crisis management.
Les débats accordent une place centrale: The debates place central emphasis on the global governance of information. Speakers advocate for greater involvement of developing countries in formulating AI regulatory frameworks. During the opening ceremony, Li Shulei, head of the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, outlined the challenges and opportunities of these technologies. Meanwhile, Yin Li, secretary of the Beijing Municipal Committee, recalled the trajectory of this summit, which was founded in 2009.
Les travaux doivent mener à plusieurs ré: The proceedings are expected to lead to several concrete achievements, notably the adoption of the seventh Beijing Consensus and the publication of the 2026 World Report on Artificial Intelligence and Media. The organizers also plan to launch an international initiative aimed at defining common standards for the use of AI in communication.
